recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則吻合成網的骨硬化（osteosclerosis），中央骨小樑旁有一團緻密的梭形細胞結節性浸潤，與周圍脂肪性骨髓分界清楚，這種骨旁結節加上骨硬化是系統性肥大細胞增生症的線索；細胞核的細節在此倍率無法判讀。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with enclosed marrow spaces (osteosclerosis)
Compact paratrabecular/perivascular cellular nodule composed of spindled to oval cells in the center of the field
Surrounding marrow is largely fatty with reduced hematopoietic tissue
Scattered small cellular spaces within sclerotic bone containing fibrous stroma and cells
Magnification is too low to confirm elongated folded mast cell nuclei; tryptase, CD117 and CD25 IHC needed
describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine at low power shows marked osteosclerosis with thickened, irregular and anastomosing trabeculae enclosing small marrow spaces. A compact, well-demarcated nodular aggregate of spindled to oval cells lies adjacent to a trabecula in the center of the field, contrasting with the surrounding fatty marrow. Cytologic detail such as elongated folded nuclei and pale cytoplasm cannot be resolved at this magnification. The combination of a paratrabecular spindle-cell nodule and osteosclerosis is consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; confirmation requires tryptase and CD117 immunostaining with aberrant CD25 expression and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: Myelofibrosis shows clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with streaming hematopoiesis and reticulin fibrosis rather than compact tryptase-positive spindle-cell aggregates.
Benign lymphoid aggregates consist of small round lymphocytes rather than spindled cells with pale cytoplasm and are tryptase and CD25 negative.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial nests with desmoplasia that are keratin positive and tryptase negative.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with numerous large osteoclasts and fibrovascular marrow without a mast cell nodule.
